**Foveation you can set up in ten seconds.** Zone sizes are now percentages that always add up. The overlay draws the zones right over the game and tells you the NR saving before you even open a frame counter.

**Measured in Forza Horizon** (7680×2160, two stacked NR passes): **15 → 25 fps** with foveation on (centre 46 × 54 %, contour 23 × 30 % at 0.44). That's 27 ms less per frame. NR's real cost dropped to 45 % of full screen, against the overlay's forecast of 42 %. [Compare the screenshots →](https://maximedgoulet.github.io/FoveatedDLSS5/?c=forza)

> **Pre-release.** Builds cleanly with MSVC and Clang. The savings the overlay shows are NR pixel counts from the add-on's own math; turn on GPU timers (Diagnostics) to see measured milliseconds next to them.

## Install

1. Download `renodx-dlss5.addon64` below.
2. In the game folder, **replace** `renodx-dlss5.addon64`. Everything else stays as in [v0.1.0](https://github.com/maximedgoulet/FoveatedDLSS5/releases/tag/v0.1.0).
3. RHI users: don't Refresh after copying, or RHI may put its own `renodx-dlss5.addon64` back.

**Upgrading from v0.3:** the pixel settings (`NRFoveationWidth`, `NRFoveationMidWidth`, `NRFoveationFalloff`, `NRFoveationBlend`, ...) are no longer read. When you switch foveation on, you start from the new default layout. Position and contour resolution (`NRFoveationCenterX/Y`, `NRFoveationEdge`) carry over.

## What's new

### Centre + contour + edge = 100 %

Per axis, the screen is split three ways:

```
EDGE: NR off, the game's own image
  CONTOUR: NR at the contour resolution
    CENTRE: NR at full resolution
```

- **Centre width / height:** the full-resolution zone, in % of the screen.
- **Contour width / height:** the thickness added around the centre, both sides together (25 % = 12.5 % per side). Its slider only goes as far as the centre leaves, and growing the centre takes the room from the contour.
- **Edge (NR off):** what's left, shown read-only.

No combination can contradict itself, and what the sliders show is what runs. (In v0.3 a midpoint slider could read 712 px while the add-on silently used 3250 px. That can't happen any more.) Turned on, the default is **50 % centre, 25 % contour, 25 % edge**: NR on 43 % of the pixels (2.3× less work) on any screen.

Fall-off and fade are now a share of the contour too: **Resolution fall-off** (50 %) and **Fade to the edge** (25 %).

### See the zones

- **Show zones on screen:** outlines the zones over the game (teal centre, amber contour, darkened edge) with the saving at the top of the screen. *Menu open* (default) draws them while the ReShade overlay is open; *Always* also while you play, to tune in motion. It's drawing only; NR's image is untouched.
- **Zone map:** a thumbnail of your screen, in its aspect ratio, with the zones as they run.

### Know the saving

**NR saving:** the share of a full-screen NR pass the layout removes (e.g. "58 % less NR work (2.4×)"), how the screen splits between centre, contour and edge, and, with **GPU timers** on, the measured NR time next to what it would be without foveation.

## New `ReShade.ini` keys

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `NRFoveationCenterW` / `NRFoveationCenterH` | `50` / `50` | Centre zone, % of the width / height (10–100) |
| `NRFoveationContourW` / `NRFoveationContourH` | `25` / `25` | Contour thickness, % of the width / height, both sides together |
| `NRFoveationFalloffPct` | `50` | Resolution fall-off, % of the contour's thickness |
| `NRFoveationBlendPct` | `25` | NR fade into the edge, % of the contour's thickness |
| `NRFoveationPreview` | `1` | Zone outlines: `0` off, `1` while the overlay is open, `2` always |

## Racing on 32:9 (Forza Horizon, BeamNG.drive, rally)

```ini
[RenoDX.DLSS5]
NRResolutionScale=1
NRFollowInputRes=0
NRFoveation=1
NRFoveationCenterW=28
NRFoveationCenterH=45
NRFoveationContourW=25
NRFoveationContourH=25
NRFoveationEdge=0.5
NRFoveationCenterY=62
```

NR on 26 % of the pixels (3.8×). With the zones on screen, nudge the vertical position until the top of the amber contour sits just above the horizon. Presets for 16:9 and 21:9 are in the [README](https://github.com/maximedgoulet/FoveatedDLSS5#presets).

## Known limits

- After-upscale NR only.
- The on-screen zone labels sit behind the ReShade overlay window, so a label can be hidden under the panel. The outlines stay visible.
- Changing foveation settings resets NR's temporal history (brief shimmer while dragging).
- New overlay text is English only.

**Coming next, in testing:** half-rate NR (NR every other frame, gated by motion) and auto-trim (sky, too dark and too bright turned off automatically).

Verify the download against `renodx-dlss5.addon64.sha256`.
